basic_details.job_title: Sakhi One Stop Centre Salem Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Case Worker, Security Guard and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Collector, Salem (under the Social Welfare and Women's Rights Department scheme) has invited applications for 8 contract posts at the Salem and Attur Sakhi One Stop Centres: 5 Case Worker, 2 Security Guard and 1 Multipurpose Helper, at consolidated pay of Rs. 18,800 for Case Worker and Rs. 12,000 for the other two posts. Download the form from www.salem.nic.in and send it in person or by post so that it reaches Room No. 126, District Social Welfare Office, by 5.00 PM on 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Eligible persons of Salem district download the application form from www.salem.nic.in.

Fill in the form: post applied for, name with initial, father's or spouse's name, age and date of birth, residential address, district, mobile number, education qualification, years of experience, police verification certificate, community certificate and Aadhaar card number.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form and write the full address and mobile number.
Send the application so that it reaches Room No. 126, District Social Welfare Office, District Collectorate Campus, First Floor, by 5.00 PM on 27 November 2026, in person or by post.
For more details, candidates may contact the District Social Welfare Office at Room No. 126, first floor of the District Collectorate campus. The notice prints no phone number or PIN code.
Application form with passport size photo, full address and mobile number
Self-attested copies of the 10th and 12th certificates, degree certificate, additional qualification certificate, experience certificate and community certificate
Self-attested ID proof and address proof
Original certificates, to be submitted at the interview
important_instructions: Applications not enclosed with the certificates mentioned in the form will strictly be rejected. The application must reach the District Social Welfare Office by 5.00 PM on 27 November 2026. All appointees are posted on rotation to provide service 24 hours a day.

content_sections.heading: About Sakhi One Stop Centre, Salem
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the Sakhi One Stop Centre is a Central Government scheme under the Social Welfare and Women's Rights Department. It has been running in Salem district since August 2018. It helps women affected by violence in the family and in public places, with emergency rescue, medical aid, mental health counselling, police help, legal help and temporary shelter. The notice says there are 2 centres in the district, at Salem and Attur, and these temporary vacancies are to be filled on contract.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 8 posts in total. The break-up by centre is given below. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of these posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The applicant must belong to Salem district. Only women may apply. Posting is on rotation to provide 24-hour service. The applicant must be a local resident. Posting is on rotation to provide 24-hour service. The applicant must be a local resident. The post is for a woman who cooks well. Posting is on rotation to provide 24-hour service. The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. For the exact discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.text: All three posts are filled on contract basis against temporary vacancies. The Case Worker receives consolidated pay of Rs. 18,800 and the Security Guard and Multipurpose Helper receive Rs. 12,000. The notice mentions no allowances. It does not state the length of the contract.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Salem Sakhi One Stop Centre recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 8 posts: 5 Case Worker (Salem 2, Attur 3), 2 Security Guard (Salem 1, Attur 1) and 1 Multipurpose Helper (Salem 1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Social Welfare Office by 5.00 PM on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Case Worker?
faq.answer: A bachelor's or master's degree in the social work and psychology stream (BSW/MSW/Counselling Psychology), with 2 years' experience as a psychological counsellor in government or private organisations preventing violence against women and children.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Security Guard and Multipurpose Helper?
faq.answer: Both posts need 10th or 12th class and 2 years' experience in a government or private office. The Multipurpose Helper must be a woman who cooks well.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Case Worker: above 23 years and within 40 years. Security Guard and Multipurpose Helper: above 21 years and within 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay is Rs. 18,800 for Case Worker and Rs. 12,000 for Security Guard and Multipurpose Helper.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.salem.nic.in, fill it in, attach a photo and self-attested certificate copies, and deliver it in person or by post to Room No. 126, District Social Welfare Office, so that it arrives by 5.00 PM on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: Only women belonging to Salem district may apply for Case Worker.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled on contract basis against temporary vacancies, with consolidated pay and rotation duty to provide 24-hour service.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be enclosed?
faq.answer: The form with photo, full address and mobile number, plus self-attested copies of the educational, experience, community, ID and address proof certificates. Originals are to be submitted at the interview.
